name: ccp
description: Code Collaboration Platform toolkit: the ship-pr skill ships uncommitted work end to end (branch, commit, PR, an ADR when architecturally significant, and a merge that only happens after you explicitly confirm it), a Stop hook nudges you when work is left unshipped, and /issues, /actions, /prs, /pr and /repo commands open the matching GitHub or GitLab view via gh or glab.
